Rana AI OS · First Order

First Order — Complete Workflow

Ye section Rana AI OS ke liye hai: Pizza Pan ka pehla order end-to-end kaise complete hoga — website, tamam social accounts, Google Map aur WhatsApp, sab automate karne ka poora plan, phase by phase. Ye poora kaam FREE DEMO ke tor par ho raha hai — owner se abhi koi len-den nahi; pasand aaye to continue karenge.

Pehle din ki haqiqat: Owner (0300-4732733) ne khud WhatsApp par 36 photos + 3 videos bheje hain — khana, pizzas, dukaan aur menu pages. Pitch + demo videos dono owner numbers (0300-4732733, 0322-7776809) par deliver ho chuke hain. Ab kaam in assets se shuru hota hai — naye photoshoot ka intezaar nahi.

0

Access & Data Collection

Day 1 · Sab se pehle

Har cheez ki buniyaad: sahi data aur sahi access. Owner se ek hi dafa, ek hi list me sab le lo taake baad me baar baar tang na karna pare. Dono owners ko ek WhatsApp group me lo — tamam approvals wahi se honge.

Kaise hoga

  • Owner ko neeche wali "Owner se chahiye" list ek message me bhejni hai
  • Fresh Gmail account Pizza Pan ke naam par — tamam accounts isi par (Rana ke paas credentials, owner ko copies)
  • Milne wali 36 photos + menu pages Drive folder me organize: Khana / Dukaan / Menu
  • Poora menu ek Google Sheet me: item, size, price — owner se verify

Risk / Note

  • Price kabhi khud guess nahi karni — jo menu page par nahi, wo owner se confirm
  • Accounts owner ke purane personal accounts par nahi — fresh business accounts
Deliverable: Verified menu sheet + photo bank + account credentials list (secure note me).
1

Website — Live Demo Tayyar

Day 1–2 · Yehi page

Jo page aap dekh rahe hain yehi Pizza Pan ki website ka pehla version hai: hero, deals (confirm rates ke saath), category-wise menu, WhatsApp order buttons (dono numbers) aur Google Maps direction. Is demo me sample food photos istemal hui hain — live version me owner ki bheji hui 36 asli photos lagein gi. Owner ko ye demo dikha kar approval lena hai.

Kaise hoga

  • Demo owner ko bhejna → design + rates par approval
  • Approval ke baad GitHub Pages par free live (jaise Rana AI OS ki site live hai)
  • Baad me apna domain (masalan pizzapan.pk type) — owner ki marzi aur budget par
  • Har deal/item ka WhatsApp deep-link: click → pehle se likha order message

Owner se chahiye

  • Design approval (ek "OK" kaafi hai)
  • Golden Deal ki price — abhi menu page se confirm nahi
  • Opening hours — abhi confirm nahi, site par is liye nahi likhe
Deliverable: Live website link — jo Google Map aur tamam social bios me lagega.
2

Google Map — Business Profile

Day 2–3 · Sab se zyada ROI

Ichhra me "pizza near me" search karne wala seedha Google Map par aata hai — ye Pizza Pan ki sab se qeemti online jagah hai. Profile claim/verify karke mukammal karna hai: sahi pin (108 Main Ferozepur Road), categories, photos, menu link, WhatsApp number.

Kaise hoga

  • Google Business Profile claim karein — agar pehle se listed hai to ownership lein
  • Verification: video ya postcard — owner ki dukaan se, Rana guide karega
  • 15–20 behtreen photos upload (owner ki bheji hui photos se)
  • Website link + menu link + dono numbers add
  • Har review ka reply 24 ghante ke andar — template ready rakhein

Owner se chahiye

  • Verification ke waqt dukaan par mojoodgi (10 minute)
  • Opening/closing time ki confirmation
  • Har khush customer se review mangne ki ijazat — counter par QR card lagega
Deliverable: Verified, mukammal Google profile — "Ichhra pizza" searches me nazar aane ke liye ready.
3

Social Accounts — Setup & Branding

Day 3–5

Facebook Page, Instagram, TikTok aur YouTube — ek hi naam, ek hi logo, ek hi bio, har jagah website + WhatsApp link. Customer jahan se bhi aaye, order ek hi jagah: WhatsApp.

Kaise hoga

  • Facebook Page + Instagram professional account (Meta Business se linked)
  • TikTok + YouTube channel Shorts ke liye
  • Profile/cover photos owner ki dukaan aur khane ki photos se
  • Bio me: address, free delivery (min Rs 600), WhatsApp order link
  • WhatsApp Business profile: catalog me top deals + menu, greeting message, away message

Owner se chahiye

  • Logo hai to file; nahi hai to Rana simple text-logo bana dega (approval owner ka)
  • WhatsApp Business app owner ke number par pehle se hai (auto-reply aa raha hai) — catalog access/coordination
Deliverable: 4 platforms live, ek jaisi branding, sab par order link.
4

Content Engine — Roz Ka Khana, Roz Ki Post

Day 5–7 se rozana

Automation ka dil. Owner ki 36 photos + 3 videos se pehla 30-din ka content bank bane ga. Har din 1 post, hafte me 3–4 Shorts/Reels — hook pehle 2 second me, captions burned-in, har video ke aakhir me WhatsApp order CTA.

Kaise hoga

  • Content calendar (Google Sheet): date, item, caption, platform, status
  • AI slideshow videos: photo + voiceover (ElevenLabs) + captions — Rana ka proven free setup
  • Schedule par auto-post; owner ko post se pehle preview (approval queue)
  • Har deal ka alag creative: Family Deal Friday, Bar B.Q weekend push
  • Hafte me 1 dafa owner se 5–10 nayi phone photos — fresh content rukna nahi chahiye

Quality check

  • Har video: voiceover ki har line vs photo match, koi khamosh scene nahi
  • Rate sirf wahi jo verified menu sheet me hai
  • Post owner-approval ke baghair live nahi (pehle mahine)
Deliverable: 30-din content bank + live calendar + rozana posts chal rahi hain.
5

WhatsApp Orders — Inbox Automation

Week 2

Posts se aanay wala customer WhatsApp par aata hai — wahan jawab slow hua to order gaya. AI agent greeting, menu, deals aur order-taking sambhale ga; mushkil ya naraz customer seedha owner/Rana ko transfer.

Kaise hoga

  • WhatsApp AI agent (Rana ka existing setup): menu/deals ke jawab verified sheet se
  • Order flow: item → quantity → naam/address → confirm → kitchen ko summary
  • Rates hamesha verified menu sheet se — agent khud rate invent nahi karega
  • Payment sawal par: owner ka bataya hua tareeqa (Easypaisa/bank) hi bhejna; na bataya ho to pehle poochhna
  • Group me service sawal aaye to group + private DM dono me jawab

Owner se chahiye

  • Delivery area ki had (2 KM free — is se bahir charges?)
  • Average delivery time (kitchen se confirm)
  • Payment tareeqa jo customers ko dena hai
Deliverable: 24/7 WhatsApp jawab + order summary system live.
6

Reviews, Report & Growth

Har hafte · Jari

Client tab rehta hai jab use numbers nazar aayein. Har hafte owner ko ek saf report: kitni posts, kitne WhatsApp orders, Google par kitne naye reviews, sab se zyada bikne wali deal.

Kaise hoga

  • Har delivered order ke baad review mangne ka message (WhatsApp)
  • Counter par Google review QR card
  • Haftawar 1-page report owner ke WhatsApp group me
  • Mahine ke aakhir me: agle mahine ka plan + nayi deal ki tajweez (data ki buniyaad par)

Upsell ka rasta

  • Foodpanda listing madad, Meta ads (chhota budget test) — pehle mahine ke results ke baad
  • Rooftop events (birthday/dawat) ki alag promotion
Deliverable: Haftawar report + badhta hua review count — yehi is client ko lambay arsay rokay ga.

Rana ke liye professional mashwara

Ye pehla order hai — isay is tarah complete karo ke yehi client doosre clients laye.

  • Pehle Google Map, phir sab kuch.

    Ichhra me search-based orders sab se pehle Map se aate hain. Website aur Insta se pehle GBP verify karna sab se tez result dega.

  • Ek waada, poora deliver.

    Owners ko jo kaha hai (sab automate hoga) use phases me dikhao — har phase ki completion par group me screenshot/report bhejo. Bharosa hi pehle client ko rakhta hai.

  • Rates kabhi guess mat karo.

    Ek ghalat rate wali post poora bharosa khatam kar sakti hai. Jo confirm nahi, wo post nahi hoga — ye rule pehle din se owner ko bata do.

  • Approval queue rakho — pehle mahina.

    Har post owner ko pehle dikhao. Dusre mahine se owner khud kahega "tum hi kar lo" — wahi asli automation ki jeet hai.

  • WhatsApp hi dukaan hai.

    Har post, har bio, har QR — sab ka aakhri step WhatsApp order. Website ka kaam sirf itna hai: customer ko WhatsApp tak pohanchana.

  • Har hafte report, bina mange.

    1-page haftawar report (posts, orders, reviews) — chhota client bhi bara mehsoos karega, aur renewal rukay ga nahi.

  • Is order ko case study banao.

    Day 1 aur Day 30 ki screenshots (followers, reviews, orders) sambhal kar rakho — agli outreach me yehi sab se bari proof hogi (owner ki ijazat se).
